description_en: Sets the maintenance mode for cloud computers
kebab_example: aliyun ecd set-desktop-maintenance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode enter --desktop-ids ecd-dzeotbgawdnfo0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDesktopMaintenance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enter or exit maintenance mode for the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 进入或退出云电脑维护模式
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud computers for which you want to set the maintenance mode. You can specify up to 100 cloud computer IDs
parameters.help_zh: 要设置维护模式的云电脑ID列表。最多支持100个云电脑ID
parameters.name: desktop_ids
